_about: Sent with a host's voice as the cTTS description when the voice doesn't speak the episode's language. Native-speaker raters preferred these locale texts; any other locale uses the template.
template: Speak natural, fluent {variety} like a native speaker, with native {language} pronunciation, intonation and rhythm, and no foreign accent.
